name: discord
title: Discord
description: Discord opt-in connector (guilds, channels, messages). Disabled by default. Mutations require Gateway HITL.

tools.name: discord_guild_list
tools.description: List guilds the bot is a member of.

tools.name: discord_channel_list
tools.description: List channels in a guild (id, type, name).

tools.name: discord_channel_messages
tools.description: List recent messages in a channel (newest first). Optional `after` snowflake for incremental fetch.

tools.name: discord_thread_list
tools.description: List active threads in a guild (includes public threads the bot can see).
